description: This file defines a React functional component named ProtectedRoute which acts as a route guardian for the application. It manages access control based on user authentication status and roles, integrating with the application's authentication context via useSupabaseAuth and routing via react-router-dom.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: A React component that restricts access to child routes based on user's authentication status and roles. Redirects unauthenticated users to /signin and unauthorized role-users to /not-authorized.
